claims.scope: This affects ALL limit order matching (both partial and full matches), while fill orders remain unaffected as they use different validation logic.

preconditions.text: A limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder.; The matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., base = 256 and quote in 1..255, or 40 & 21).
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A legitimate limit order match whose matched base and quote amounts are both nonzero must not be rejected as a zero-cost trade.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: This affects ALL limit order matching (both partial and full matches), while fill orders remain unaffected as they use different validation logic.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The matched base and quote amounts are observable quantities of the limit order match at the validation checkpoint.
The zero-cost validation is the check that can reject a legitimate match as a zero-cost trade.

limitations: The disjoint-1-bits precondition is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report states the condition qualitatively with examples but does not define a single numeric predicate over the matched amounts.
The impact text describes scope (all limit order matching, partial and full) rather than a distinct numeric outcome; V is encoded as the reported revert occurrence.
Fill orders are reported as unaffected; this claim formalizes only the limit order matching impact.
